name: groundwork
description: Whole-app UI/UX planning for AI builders. Groundwork codifies the product schema, requirements, flows, screens, states, design patterns, architecture, implementation plan, and acceptance criteria into one traceable builder packet. Start with /groundwork:run.

interface.shortDescription: Plan a whole app and codify its UI/UX and system design.
interface.longDescription: Groundwork plans a whole app before production code changes. It turns an idea or existing product into one canonical product schema covering requirements, UX flows, screens and states, design patterns, architecture, implementation tasks, tests, and acceptance criteria, then emits a traceable builder packet.
defaultPrompt: Plan this whole app by capturing what is already decided and identifying the design gaps.
Plan this whole app and codify its product schema, UI/UX, architecture, and build plan.
Plan the app's visual direction and codify the UI patterns to build.
Compare version A and version B of these screens and record my decisions.
